plugins.name: dragon-agents
plugins.description: Research subagents for repo, markets, personal-data, music-collection, machine-health, and school-schedule work, charter design, the Calibre import pipeline's gated execution seat plus its read-only phase auditor, five fence-gated audit-and-fix seats, a purpose-built web-research report writer, a two-mode repo and idea grader, a GitHub-metadata tender (repo descriptions and topics via gh, propose-first, read-back verified), a propose-first release executor (verbatim tags and GitHub Releases after a ready verdict, every mutation read back), a multimodal pixel judge for app, game, and desktop captures (JSON verdicts, never drives the UI), an open-issue census seat, a reference-docs propagation auditor, an upstream-sync window triager for reference clones, an Obsidian vault hygiene auditor (read-only, connections proposed never applied), a subscription watchdog over exported statement CSVs (dormant until statements exist), a read-only repo-marketing seat (placement analysis against live channel rules, channel-native launch drafts from repo artifacts, paid-ad verdicts with arithmetic; never posts, drafts land in the final message only), and the vendored official Obsidian skill set plus the in-repo herald skill, the Reddit presence buffer (both MIT, attributed).
